title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：occupation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 occupation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the foreman ① chose the occupation that no worker in the site would have counted, and he said the choosing was the whole of the shift. The ② occupation, meaning the job itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed uncounted in the book; an occupation, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ occupation in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ occupation at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An occupation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the foreman said the counting is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the occupation was the whole of the matter, meaning the living and not the job. The ⑥ occupation, meaning the living and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; occupation, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a job and a living. He said the living is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ occupation had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ occupation of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of counting; occupation, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ occupation I remember is the job counted in the sheet, which closed in 1970 and is still counted as the quietest in the site. An ⑩ occupation, my mother said in 1972, is the only job that improves by being counted; every occupation, she said, is a living that has agreed to look like a job. She said the living was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 职业；工作（指工地里每一门旁边的那一门）
B. n. 职业；工作（指那门职业本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the occupation 选定这一门职业
D. n. 职业；工作（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 职业之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的职业之事）
F. n. 职业；工作（指施工单里写到、被清点的那一门）
G. n. 职业、营生（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 营生（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the occupation that no worker in the site would have counted
The occupation, meaning the job itself and not the rope
the occupation at the far ramp
the occupation was the whole of the matter
the occupation had become a line in a sheet
The occupation of the whole thing
An occupation, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: choose the occupation 意为“选定这一门职业”，1963 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯清点的一门职业做了一遍。
occupation 意为“职业；工作”，指那门职业本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被清点。
occupation 意为“职业；工作”，指工地里每一门旁边的那一门，每一门旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
occupation 意为“职业；工作”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
occupation 意为“职业、营生”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门营生就是那件事的全部。
occupation 意为“营生”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门职业，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
occupation 意为“职业；工作”，指施工单里写到、被清点的那一门，到 1968 年这一门成了施工单里的一行。
occupation 意为“职业之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的职业之事是一处工地和三个班次的清点。
occupation 意为“职业；工作”，我记得的是施工单里清点过的那一门，1970 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一门。
occupation 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，职业是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的职业。
